title: Print the invoked CLI name in hints and drop tool-specific provenance examples
description: Hints print 'kbs ...' commands even when the user ran 'kanbus'; generated text says 'Prefer kbs (Rust)', which misleads on machines with a stale kbs (Biblicus Mac had kbs 0.24/0.32 on PATH). Provenance hints cite 'Cursor / Composer 2.5'. Wanted: hints use the name of the running binary (kbs or kanbus), identical wording otherwise across runtimes; provenance examples generic.
